newsitem.title: SWEDEN: POLL-Swedish June trade surplus seen 12.8 bln skr.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Swedish June trade surplus seen 12.8 bln skr.

text.p: Sweden's trade balance for June was expected to show a surplus of 12.8 billion crowns, a poll of analysts by Reuters showed on Monday.
Forecasts ranged from 10.9 billion to 15 billion crowns.
The trade balance showed a surplus of 11.1 billion crowns in May this year and 13.6 billion crowns in June 1996.
The full-year trade surplus was expected to total 123.2 billion crowns, the average of six survey responses showed. Forecasts ranged from 117 billion to 130 billion crowns.
In 1996 the trade surplus was 120 billion crowns.
Statistics Sweden is due to publish the figure at 0805 GMT on July 25.

Sources who participated in this poll included: Aragon, Chase, Consensus, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, JP Morgan, Nomura, Nordbanken, Penser, S-E-Banken, Sparbanken and UBS.
